# Condition Group

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ConditionGroup`](gmeow-ConditionGroup.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ConditionGroup>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A composite condition — all-of, any-of, or none-of its members (arbitrary and/or/not trees by nesting groups). Requires an operator and at least two members (SHACL). A group is itself a [`Condition`](gmeow-Condition.md): it carries its own prose summary and can be evaluated, formalized, and reused like any other.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Condition`](gmeow-Condition.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ConditionGroup`](gmeow-ConditionGroup.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Condition`](gmeow-Condition.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Condition`](gmeow-Condition.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to combine member conditions with explicit and/or/not logic — nest groups for arbitrary boolean trees.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for a single condition (use a plain [`gmeow:Condition`](gmeow-Condition.md)) and avoid an under-filled group — it requires an operator and at least two members (SHACL).

### How to use

- Mint the group, set [`gmeow:groupOperator`](../properties/gmeow-groupOperator.md), attach at least two [`gmeow:groupMember`](../properties/gmeow-groupMember.md) conditions, and give it its own [`gmeow:conditionText`](../properties/gmeow-conditionText.md) summary; it behaves as a [`Condition`](gmeow-Condition.md) everywhere.

### Examples

- ex:cg1 a [`gmeow:ConditionGroup`](gmeow-ConditionGroup.md); [`gmeow:groupOperator`](../properties/gmeow-groupOperator.md) [`gmeow:operatorAll`](../individuals/gmeow-operatorAll.md); [`gmeow:groupMember`](../properties/gmeow-groupMember.md) ex:c1, ex:c2.
